questions.text: What is the single most overrated thing that everyone around you seems to love? Defend your position.
What's genuinely underrated and deserves way more credit than it gets?
What food combination do you enjoy that other people call a crime?
What is a completely trivial hill you would genuinely die on?
Name a beloved film you think is actually bad. Explain before the pitchforks come out.
Which sequel is better than the original, and why is everyone wrong about it?
Which common tradition or social ritual would you quietly abolish if you could?
What's one piece of etiquette people get wrong constantly that low-key drives you up the wall?
What is objectively the best condiment, and what is the worst? Full arguments only.
Settle it: is cereal a soup, is a hot dog a sandwich, and does the answer to one force the answer to the other?
Shoes on or off in the house — and how strongly do you police this in your own home?
Which franchise should be legally barred from making anything else, and which deserves ten more entries?
Which holiday is the most overrated, and which one deserves a bigger deal made of it?
At what age does someone actually become an adult? Not legally — actually.
Rank the top three pizza toppings and name the one that should be taken off menus entirely.
Name one case where the film is better than the book. Go on, be brave.
Was music better twenty years ago, or does everyone just say that at a certain age?
You may permanently delete one vegetable from existence. Which one, and who does it hurt?
Which social platform has done the most damage, and which is the least bad?
Is reclining your seat on a plane acceptable? Armrest rules? Set the law.
What is one rule every group chat should have and almost none do?
How long after release does something stop being a spoiler? Give a number and defend it.
What's the greatest sandwich, all-time, no bracket needed? Yes you have to pick one.
Are morning people genuinely happier, or are they just smug about it?
Should adults still get a fuss made on their birthday, or is it time to let it go?
Subtitles on for everything, or only when you must? This says a lot about a person.
What's a widely accepted design choice — in homes, offices, apps, cars — that you think is objectively bad?
Which household chore is genuinely the worst, and which one do you secretly enjoy?
Are gift cards a thoughtful present or an admission of defeat?
What should every restaurant be required to do that most of them don't?
What's the driving habit that turns you into a completely different person?
What are people wrong to be nostalgic about? Something that was actually worse back then.
Do awards mean anything any more, in any field? Where's the strongest counter-example?
Best decade for music, and you must give a reason that isn't 'that's when I grew up'.
Calling someone without texting first: reasonable, or a hostile act?
How many days do leftovers get in your house, and what's the one food you'd never risk?
Which fashion trend needs to stay buried, and which one deserves a comeback?
What's the correct buffet strategy, and what's the amateur mistake everyone makes?
Is rewatching the same show for the tenth time comfort or avoidance? Be honest about which one you're doing.
What's the most pointless thing employers do in the name of team spirit?
Best fast food chain, worst fast food chain, and the one item that's better than the whole menu it's on.
Do you read the instructions first, or do you build it and see which screws are left over?
What piece of old technology was straight-up better than what replaced it?
What expensive thing is a complete waste of money, and what cheap thing is worth every penny?
Which decade would be the worst to be transported to, and what would break you first?
What's the worst sound in the world? Not scary — just genuinely unbearable.
